title: Suicide risk prediction for Korean adolescents based on machine learning.
summary: Six ML models were compared on the 2022 Korean Youth Risk Behavior Survey (51,850 adolescents); outcomes were ideation, planning or attempts in the preceding year. GBM reported 88% accuracy, 97% sensitivity, 26% specificity and AUC 0.83. Testing: National survey data and model comparisons support retrospective prediction, not clinical triage; low specificity (26%) and one survey setting constrain use.. Source affiliation was not stated in the reviewed case checks and was unavailable in the local bibliographic cache.
